company.heading: Our Company
company.body1: Founded in 2015, ATech Solutions has grown from a small startup to a globally recognized software development partner. We specialize in building scalable, innovative solutions for businesses of all sizes.
company.body2: With over 500 successful projects delivered and a team of 200+ expert developers, we've established ourselves as a trusted technology partner across multiple industries and continents.

mission.missionBody: To empower businesses worldwide by delivering cutting-edge software solutions that drive innovation, efficiency, and growth. We are committed to transforming complex challenges into simple, elegant solutions.
mission.visionBody: To be the world's most trusted technology partner, leading the digital transformation revolution and creating a future where technology seamlessly enhances human potential and business success.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: Find answers to common questions about working with ATech Solutions.

items.question: What is your typical project timeline?
items.answer: Project timelines vary based on scope and complexity. A typical MVP takes 8–12 weeks, while larger enterprise projects may take 6–12 months. We always provide a detailed timeline during our initial proposal.

items.question: How do you handle project pricing?
items.answer: We provide transparent, customized pricing based on your specific project requirements. After our initial consultation, we'll deliver a detailed proposal outlining the scope, timeline, and cost breakdown. We offer flexible engagement models including fixed-price projects, time and materials, and dedicated team arrangements.

items.question: What technologies do you work with?
items.answer: We work with a wide range of technologies including React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Go, AWS, GCP, Azure, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and many more. Our team stays current with the latest tools and frameworks.

items.question: Do you provide ongoing support after project completion?
items.answer: Yes, we offer comprehensive post-launch support and maintenance packages. Our team ensures your product stays up-to-date, secure, and performing optimally after delivery.

items.question: Can you work with our existing development team?
items.answer: Absolutely. We regularly augment in-house teams, providing specialist skills and additional capacity while integrating seamlessly with your existing workflows and tools.

items.question: How do you ensure project security and confidentiality?
items.answer: All team members sign NDAs, we follow industry security best practices, and we can adhere to specific compliance requirements (HIPAA, SOC 2, GDPR, etc.) relevant to your project.
